title: Engineering baseline content custody
description: Model management supplies exact retained content, isolated recovery and state-bound current-model retirement to Governance; content custody is distinct from baseline meaning, authority and operational history.

operations.name: retain_baseline_content
operations.purpose: Retain an exact immutable baseline bundle and confirm actual custody.
inputs: Project/baseline and request identities, exact immutable source manifest/content, original profile/rules and included provenance/material.
Selected retention policy, authority and complete coherence support, with external-only references distinguished.
preconditions: The selected project, exact subject and requested scope are identifiable; missing required support is an explicit gap, not an assumed favorable result.
outputs: Exact sealed bundle and manifest identity with confirmed durable custody, or partial/unsupported/failed/unconfirmed effects.
behavior: MOD-016 composes exact IF-001 custody with IF-002 interpretation and whole-model conformance for the supplied captured basis; no recursive acquisition or baseline-catalog authority.

Apply MOD-017 state-control.md immutable custody; stage complete selected bytes separately from mutable current definitions, verify integrity and durably publish without replacing another baseline binding.
Preserve included original rules and supplied material; do not fetch external references, adopt current state or establish a baseline catalog entry.
Read back sealed membership before confirming; reconcile request-bound effects after lost receipt and preserve sealed-but-unregistered content.

failure_behavior.condition: Required material, scope integrity, supported member kind, authority or durability is unestablished.
failure_behavior.outcome: Withhold complete confirmation and expose affected scope without silent substitution.
Report known and uncertain effects; preserve sealed originals and do not blindly replay or claim rollback.

operations.name: read_baseline_content
operations.purpose: Read exact sealed retained engineering content.
inputs: Exact baseline/bundle identity and requested member scope.
preconditions: The selected project, exact subject and requested scope are identifiable; missing required support is an explicit gap, not an assumed favorable result.
outputs: Original immutable manifest/content and selected rules, with complete, partial, corrupt, unsupported or unavailable scope.
Original interpreted identity/relationship facts, with exact governing basis and unsupported or unavailable interpretation scope.
behavior: Verify exact manifest membership and content integrity before declaring complete access.
Return original bytes and provenance; newer definitions or rules cannot substitute for unavailable originals.
MOD-016 passes the exact retained content and original rules to MOD-003 through IF-002; return interpreted facts and explicit interpretation gaps separately from raw integrity/access outcomes.

failure_behavior.condition: Identity, required member, integrity or access cannot be established.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return precise known/unavailable scope; missing data is not absence or a complete interpreted state.

operations.name: recover_baseline_content
operations.purpose: Materialize retained content into a newly owned isolated recovery area.
inputs: Exact sealed baseline manifest/content and requested scope; selected parent for a newly created isolated output.
preconditions: The selected project, exact subject and requested scope are identifiable; missing required support is an explicit gap, not an assumed favorable result.
outputs: Owned output identity, reproduced membership/content and fidelity observations, or partial/failed/uncertain result.
behavior: MOD-016 composes IF-001 exact retained reads/materialization and IF-002 original interpretation, preserving separate fidelity and interpretation outcomes.
Apply state-control.md containment and isolated materialization; reject existing/active-work destinations and escaped or aliased paths.
Compare full output manifest, bytes and supported recorded attributes against the retained basis; caller assesses original interpretation and full recovery meaning.
Do not modify retained history or active work; cleanup only owned temporary output.

failure_behavior.condition: Output already exists, source integrity fails, member kinds are unsupported, access fails or materialization is interrupted.
failure_behavior.outcome: Withhold complete recovery, preserve source/active work and disclose actual partial or unavailable scope.
Inspect exact owned output/request before reconciling; do not infer failure or authorize overwrite.

operations.name: retire_current_model_material
operations.purpose: Apply an exact authorized current-model retirement candidate.
inputs: Expected model state, exact removal/replacement inventory and supported resulting candidate.
Applicable authority, resolved reliance dispositions, required exact original recovery and complete resulting-model check basis.

Accountable executor and established maintenance interval covering all relevant model, operational, external dependency/replacement and authority writers through final checks, effects and reconciliation.
preconditions: The selected project, exact subject and requested scope are identifiable; missing required support is an explicit gap, not an assumed favorable result.
The executor holds the state-control.md cross-custody stability boundary; inability to establish or retain it withholds removal. Model exclusion or a revision recheck alone is insufficient.
outputs: Exact actual current-state effects and resulting state, or invalid/stale/partial/unresolved effect scope.
behavior: MOD-016 composes MOD-001 custody through IF-001 and MOD-003 supported checks through IF-002; never invoke operational record deletion.
Apply state-control.md retirement under model write exclusion and final expected-base/authority checks; delegate resulting candidate checks to IF-002.
Publish required replacements before removing selected current members, with durable unresolved-write metadata before effects.
Never remove retained bundles/history, silently broaden scope or conflate prepared readiness with actual completion.
Preserve incomplete publication and withhold coherent affected reads/further writes until reconciled.

Preserve the maintenance interval through actual effect inspection and outcome retention; loss/interruption blocks further affected work and requires explicit stable-scope reconciliation before release/resumption.

failure_behavior.condition: Expected base, authority, recovery, dependencies or candidate checks no longer support removal.
failure_behavior.outcome: Withhold affected action and require reconciliation without overwriting intervening work.
Report actual effects and block coherent affected access; no blind retry or assumed rollback.

failure_behavior.condition: Required writer quiescence/exclusion is absent, lost or cannot survive safe interruption handling.
failure_behavior.outcome: Withhold or stop removal, report actual partial/unconfirmed effects and retain blocked-scope recovery information; do not infer completed retirement or safe resumed access.

consistency_rules: MOD-016 owns the composed boundary; MOD-001 owns content custody, MOD-003 original interpretation/checks and MOD-005 baseline identity/catalog and complete recovery claims.
IF-007 remains read-only inspection. Exact source membership, rules, integrity, authority and actual effects remain attributable and separate.
No operation silently adopts a recovered/migrated state, overwrites active work, changes operational records or releases retained history.
compatibility_rules: Proposed logical operations only; no new public command, wire schema, selected storage migration or installed runtime.
Use the qualified custody adapter and supported material kinds; unsupported semantics remain explicit. Existing IF-001/002/007 guarantees survive.

sources.basis: Define immutable baseline custody, original-meaning comparison/recovery, attributable transition preparation and dependency-safe retirement. Preserve selective retention and separate action authority, operational maintenance and actual execution; proposed Design only.
